'''Yu Dakar''' was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'lek]] who worked as a [[Merchant/Legends|vendor]] on the [[Keylander Station]] during the the events of the [[Conquest of Makeb]]. She would be later found on the [[Moon/Legends|moon]] [[CZ-198]] during the [[Seizure of CZ-198]].

{{Char-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
She was later removed in Game Update 5.0 on [[November 29]], [[2016]], which retired the PvP and PvE gear vendors in favor of the Command system.<ref name="5.0">{{TORweb|url=patchnotes/11292016/game-update-5.0-knights-eternal-throne-early-access|text=Game Update 5.0: Knights of the Eternal Throne Early Access Patch Notes}}</ref>
